{{Top|leg}}
An '''automatic interrogation response circuit''' was a system fitted on military and law enforcement [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. In concert with a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scan, the automatic interrogation response circuit revealed the identity of a target ship.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
